nexthook:
THE TRAIN MOVES.
NOTHING BOARDS IT ABOVE 20.
lines:
YOU DROVE ON. THEIR LIGHTS
NEVER CAME BACK.

AND THE ROAD IS ABOUT TO
COST YOU THE CAR.

ROADS SOUTH END HERE.
SIX MILES. ONE BRIDGE.

YOU LEAVE ON YOUR TERMS.
AND TAKE THE RAILWAY.

RECOVERY IN SIX DAYS.
RAIL STAFF: GONE DAY 1.

A LOCOMOTIVE. IDLING.
NOBODY IN THE CAB.

BETWEEN YOU AND THE TRAIN:
A SIGNAL BOX. ONE DOOR.

4:55 AM. YOU GO IN
FOR THE YARD KEYS.

RAIL STAFF: GONE DAY 1.
THE RADIO SAID SO.

THEN THE LOOP PLAYS PAST
WHERE IT EVER HAS.
